management_steps.details: Pityriasis versicolor: lather shampoo on affected parts, leave on overnight, wash off following day, once weekly for 3 weeks. Scalp/dandruff: lather on scalp, rinse off after 10 minutes, apply weekly until improved, then every second week to maintain control.
Topical treatment for fungal/scaling scalp and skin conditions.
